title: Construction of a locally finitely presented universal rank-match representative
statement: Let f : X → S be flat, proper and locally of finite presentation, and let E be a finite locally free module on X. There exist a scheme W′ and an immersion j′ : W′ → S locally of finite presentation such that, for every g : T → S, g factors through j′ if and only if PicardUniversalRankMatch f E g (def-sc-picard-universal-rank-match). This construction assumes no pre-existing representing immersion and asserts no comparison isomorphism.

source.place: Tags 0BDP, first three proof paragraphs; 0B91; 0BDL. Rank decomposition adapted to omit the structure-pushforward hypothesis by excluding mixed-rank fibres.

proof.text: Apply the single-image locally finitely presented locus theorem to F=E and F=dual E, using finite local freeness of dual E. Obtain two immersions j1 and j2 and their single-image universal properties.
Their fibre product over S has structural map pullback.fst followed by j1. Immersion and local finite presentation follow from the Mathlib base-change and composition instances.

The simultaneous rank condition implies the two single conditions by dropping one direct-image rank witness each time. The converse is the synchronization theorem, including empty inverse images without any structure-sheaf assumption.

A factor through the fibre product projects to factors through each locus. Conversely the two single conditions give factors a,b through j1,j2, and their equal composites to S permit pullback.lift a b. Its first projection identity proves the required factorization. This is the universal property claimed by the original theorem.

proof_origin.place: Tags 0BDP, 0B91 and 0BDL; X2 Lean assembly through one single-image locus applied twice, with a fully proved synchronization lemma including empty fibres.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_picardUniversalRankMatchLocus_finitePresentation_core
    {X S : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) [Flat f] [IsProper f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    (E : X.Modules) [E.IsFiniteLocallyFree] :
    ∃ (W' : Scheme.{u}) (j' : W' ⟶ S),
      IsImmersion j' ∧ LocallyOfFinitePresentation j' ∧
      ∀ {T : Scheme.{u}} (g : T ⟶ S),
        (∃ h : T ⟶ W', h ≫ j' = g) ↔ PicardUniversalRankMatch f E g
